t: This is Spencer House, a Grade I listed town house at 27 St James's Place. The architect was John Vardy, a follower of the neo-Palladian William Kent. The house has seen many lives. John Spencer, later the third Earl Spencer, was born here. He became Chancellor of the Exchequer and was nicknamed Honest Jack for his integrity. Woolf Barnato was born here too. He was one of the Bentley Boys and won Le Mans three times from three starts. Princess Anastasia of Greece and Denmark died here, as did Harriet Marsham. Jacob Rothschild, the investment banker and philanthropist, later owned it.
